Stellenangebot: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) Für unser Unternehmen, einen führenden SaaS-Enablement-Dienstleister , suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) .

SingularitySales ist bekannt für erstklassige Leistungen im Bereich Go-to-Market und der Skalierung innovativer Softwarelösungen. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine moderne Unternehmenskultur, die Offenheit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung fördert.

Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du eine zentrale Säule unseres Vertriebsteams im Bereich Enterprise Industrial Software und spielst eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau und Closing strategischer Deals mit Großkunden aus dem Fertigungsumfeld.

Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Kundenbedarfe präzise zu analysieren, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen zu präsentieren und Entscheidungsträger bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss zu begleiten. Dabei baust du langfristige Partnerschaften auf und positionierst das Produkt-Portfolio strategisch in deinem Marktbereich.

Wenn du dich durch exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, starkes Business-Verständnis im industriellen Umfeld und eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz im Closing komplexer Enterprise-Deals auszeichnest, freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung.

Dich erwartet eine anspruchsvolle Rolle mit hoher Verantwortung – und die Möglichkeit, deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu bringen, eingebettet in ein dynamisches Umfeld, das lebenslanges Lernen, Entwicklung und gemeinsame Erfolge fördert.

Sei Teil eines Teams, das mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen vorantreibt, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele realisiert. Requirements Deine Mission: Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Outsourcing-Teams für einen führenden Anbieter industrieller Softwarelösungen.

Deine Mission: den kompletten Sales-Cycle eigenverantwortlich zu steuern – von der präzisen Analyse der Kundenbedarfe über die Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Enterprise-Lösungen bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei agierst du als vertrauensvoller Partner im Namen unseres Kunden, baust langfristige Beziehungen mit Entscheidungsträgern auf und positionierst das Portfolio strategisch im Markt. Mit deinem Beitrag stellst du sicher, dass Wachstum messbar wird und die Sales-Exzellenz unseres Kunden nachhaltig gestärkt wird.

Deine Aufgaben: Closing & Deal Ownership: Verantwortung für den gesamten Abschlussprozess – vom ersten Meeting (ausführliche Discovery und Business Case) bis hin zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung.

Kundenberatung: Analyse komplexer Anforderungen aus dem Manufacturing- und Industrieumfeld, Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Softwarelösungen und Positionierung des Produktportfolios als strategischer Mehrwert.

Beziehungsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Entscheidern und Key Accounts in Fertigungsunternehmen, um nachhaltiges Wachstum zu sichern. Vertriebsstrategie: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Ansätzen im Namen des Kunden, mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Impact im industriellen Enterprise-Umfeld.

CRM- & Pipeline-Management: Sicherstellen einer präzisen Forecasting- und Opportunity-Steuerung im CRM-System, um volle Transparenz über den Sales-Funnel zu gewährleisten. Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse: Beobachtung von Trends im Bereich Industrial Software & Manufacturing, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und Kunden proaktiv zu beraten.

Reporting & KPI-Steuerung: Erstellung von regelmäßigen Berichten zu Sales-Performance, Conversion Rates und Forecasts für Management und Stakeholder. Dein Profil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Solution-Selling, idealerweise im Bereich Enterprise Software, Industrial Software oder SaaS im Fertigungsumfeld.

Nachweisbare Erfolge im Closing komplexer Deals und in der Erreichung oder Übertreffung ambitionierter Vertriebsziele. Tiefes Verständnis für industrielle Geschäftsmodelle sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Softwarelösungen in klaren Business-Value zu übersetzen.

Starke kommunikative und überzeugende Fähigkeiten auf C-Level – schriftlich, telefonisch und in Präsentationen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Forecasting und Opportunity-Management. Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit Hands-on-Mentalität, um Kunden durch den gesamten Sales Cycle zu führen.

Hohe Eigenmotivation, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich zu agieren. Wir bieten: 100% Remote – arbeite von wo du willst, in einem globalen Team mit echtem Impact. Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket inklusive leistungsbezogener Boni.

Direkter Zugang zu Entscheidern – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Ein Umfeld, das High Performer fordert und fördert – ohne Corporate-Bremsen. Ein engagiertes und leidenschaftliches Team, das Werte wie Innovation, Integrität und Teamarbeit hochhält.

At Summit , we're on the lookout for talent that doesn't just think "outside the box," but brings their own unique perspective to the table. With our relentless pursuit of excellence and curiosity, we lead innovation in our industry.

We humanize technology by actively listening to our clients, crafting tailored proposals, and delivering on the promise of technology with precision and purpose. As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will own and grow a portfolio of existing customers (250-300 accounts), focusing on retention, expansion, and long-term account development.

This role is centered on building strong relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring customers realize ongoing value from Summit ’s solutions.

This is a role for individuals who are energized by account ownership and long-term growth, where maintaining and expanding recurring revenue directly impacts both customer success and earning potential.

You’ll partner closely with customers to understand their evolving needs, identify opportunities for expansion, and guide them through solution enhancements over time. Success in this role comes from proactive engagement, strong account planning, and the ability to balance retention with growth.

What You’ll Do: Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts across infrastructure, cloud, and managed services Maintain regular, proactive engagement with customers to understand evolving needs and identify growth opportunities Identify and drive upsell, cross-sell, and service expansion opportunities within existing accounts Own renewal strategy and execution, ensuring retention and long-term account stability Partner with internal teams to align solutions with customer needs and priorities Monitor account health, usage trends, and risk signals to proactively address churn and contraction Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility for expansion opportunities What You’ll Deliver: Strong net revenue retention and growth across your portfolio Expansion of recurring revenue through upgrades, add-ons, and new services High customer satisfaction and long-term account stability Clear account plans with visibility into risks, opportunities, and next steps Consistent achievement of retention and growth targets You’ll Thrive in This Role If You: Are comfortable owning long-term customer relationships and revenue outcomes Are motivated by performance tied to both retention and expansion of revenue Take a proactive, structured approach to account planning and growth Can identify expansion opportunities and confidently position additional solutions Balance strong relationship management with a focus on revenue outcomes Stay organized and disciplined across multiple accounts and priorities Bonus Points: Experience in account management within infrastructure, cloud, or managed services Strong understanding of recurring revenue models Experience driving expansion within existing customer bases Ability to navigate technical conversations and solution positioning How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do.

At Summit , our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers. We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it.

Our core values: Empower our people Constant elevation Customer first Focus on outcomes Embrace curiosity Benefits: Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

Here’s a snapshot of what that looks like: Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it Medical, Dental & Vision – comprehensive coverage with HSA/HRA options 401(k) with 4% match – we invest alongside you Parental Leave – paid time for the moments that matter most Life & Disability Insurance – built-in peace of mind Wellness Support – resources for your mental and physical health Free Colocation & Cloud Access – build and experiment in real environments Work From Anywhere – remote-friendly by design A low-ego, get-it-done culture – come as you are, do great work Compensation & Earnings Potential This role is designed for individuals who are motivated by both retaining and growing revenue within an existing customer base.

Compensation includes a performance-based component tied to net revenue retention and account growth, rewarding both stability and expansion. With clear targets and accelerator opportunities tied to performance, strong account management and expansion efforts directly translate into increased earnings.

Earn a base salary of $85,000–$105,000 annually. Combined with the commission plan, you have the opportunity to double your base salary through strong performance. We aim to make offers that feel fair, forward-looking, and reflective of what you bring to the table, and where you want to grow.

Summit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. As part of this commitment, Summit will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations.

Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry? Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way.

Tempus ' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

The MRD Clinical Account Executive is responsible for promoting and selling Tempus 's Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) testing services to clinicians and healthcare providers.

The role involves strategic business development, collaboration with key stakeholders, and driving the adoption of MRD testing within academic medical centers, health systems, and community practices. Responsibilities:
Drive the adoption of Tempus 's MRD testing services within the specified territory, focusing on major U.S. cancer centers, health systems, and community practices.
Engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinicians, and decision-makers to establish and expand business opportunities.
Develop strategic plans for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones, maximizing client-bill contracting opportunities.
Implement laboratory services agreements (LSAs) with institutions that opt for client billing.
Collaborate with various sales roles within Tempus to ensure the attainment of company goals and objectives.
Identify and develop partnership opportunities between oncology clients and Tempus , promoting the integration of MRD testing into clinical practice.
Provide feedback to Tempus leadership based on market analysis and competitive landscape within assigned accounts.
Develop and implement a comprehensive business plan for the territory, including budgets, travel, territory management, and goal setting.
Represent Tempus 's company culture with integrity, respect, and trust to both external and internal stakeholders.

Proven ability to sell integrated molecular diagnostic solutions and engage in consultative selling processes.
Comfortable engaging with executive-level stakeholders (CEO, COO, CFO).
In-depth understanding of the payer and reimbursement environment in oncology diagnostics.
Independent work ethic with strong communication, project management, and prioritization skills.
Knowledgeable about molecular diagnostics, MRD testing, and the competitive landscape in oncology.
Proficient in Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and regular use of Salesforce.com.
Ability to develop cross-functional relationships to facilitate work goals and objectives.
Advanced presentation skills, business acumen, and the ability to work effectively with minimal direction.

B.S. in life science, biology, business, or marketing – MBA preferred.
3+ years of direct account management experience in a molecular diagnostic setting, with a focus on MRD testing preferred.
Proven track record of revenue generation in a diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology company.
Experience working with major cancer centers, oncology GPOs, large health systems, and oncology practices.

Bei Shiftmove entwickeln wir die nächste Generation vernetzter Mobilitätsprodukte, mit denen Unternehmen fundierte, datenbasierte Entscheidungen treffen können. Unser Ziel ist es, komplexe Abläufe intuitiv und effizient zu gestalten – und aus Daten echten Mehrwert für tausende B2B-Kund:innen in ganz Europa und darüber hinaus zu schaffen.
Als Associate Account Executive (B2B Sales) bist du Teil unseres SMB Sales Teams und arbeitest in einer festen Pod-Struktur eng mit erfahrenen Account Executives zusammen. Du verantwortest den Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen, identifizierst Verkaufschancen und unterstützt aktiv entlang des gesamten Sales-Prozesses. Dabei entwickelst du dich Schritt für Schritt zu einer eigenverantwortlichen Rolle im B2B-Vertrieb.
Wenn du gerne auf Menschen zugehst, ambitioniert bist und deine Karriere im B2B-Sales starten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Deine Aufgaben
Neukunden gewinnen: Du identifizierst und kontaktierst potenzielle Kund:innen im deutschsprachigen Raum über verschiedene Kanäle und baust durch überzeugende Gespräche kontinuierlich neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten auf.
Opportunities qualifizieren: Du analysierst die Anforderungen potenzieller Kund:innen, bewertest Verkaufschancen anhand klarer Kriterien und vereinbarst gemeinsam mit deinem Pod qualifizierte Gespräche mit hoher Terminqualität und Show-Rate.
Im Sales Cycle mitwirken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Account Executive zusammen, unterstützt bei Discovery Calls und übernimmst mit wachsender Erfahrung schrittweise mehr Verantwortung im Vertriebsprozess.
Pipeline aufbauen: Du baust durch konsequentes Follow-up eine nachhaltige Pipeline auf, hältst Kontakte aktiv und reaktivierst bestehende Leads.
Teamwork & CRM: Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Sales Pod zusammen, trägst zu gemeinsamen Zielen bei und dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert in Salesforce.
Was du mitbringen solltest
Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in einer performance-orientierten Rolle: Sales, Recruiting, Kundenakquise oder Business Development, ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss.
Freude an Outbound: Du gehst gerne aktiv auf Menschen zu und fühlst dich am Telefon wohl.
Hoher eigener Anspruch: Du möchtest lernen, wie moderner B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb funktioniert, und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter.
Struktur & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und verlierst deine Ziele nicht aus dem Blick.
Resilienz & Durchhaltevermögen: Ablehnung motiviert dich, statt dich auszubremsen.
Klare Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst klar, überzeugend und auf Augenhöhe.
Sprachen: Deutsch C2, Englisch mind. B2
Warum Shiftmove?
Lerne den gesamten Sales-Prozess: Du arbeitest vom ersten Tag an eng mit erfahrenen Account Executives zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in den gesamten Customer Journey – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis hin zu erfolgreichen Kundengesprächen.
Steile Lernkurve: Regelmäßiges Coaching, direktes Feedback und die Zusammenarbeit im Pod ermöglichen dir eine schnelle persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung.
Klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen die Voraussetzungen, damit du langfristig mehr Verantwortung im Vertrieb übernehmen kannst.
Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen komplexe Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in Europa und helfen ihnen dabei, ihre Flottenprozesse datengetrieben und effizient zu steuern.
Performance-Kultur: Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, messen Ergebnisse und unterstützen uns gegenseitig dabei, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Urlaub: 30 Tage
Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr weltweit remote arbeiten
Hundefreundliches Office: Vierbeinige Kolleg:innen sind willkommen 🐶
Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
Hauptbenefits: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony-Abo, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum BVG-Ticket
Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day + Zugang zu nilo.health
Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen 1× pro Woche, regelmäßiges Company Breakfast sowie Getränke & Snacks
Administrative Infos

Standort: Berlin

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards.

It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot.

You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention. This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

s.h: The Person We Are Looking For
s.t:
We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it.

You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.
You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call. You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction
Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit
Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.
Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.
Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.
Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.
Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.

Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.
Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.
Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.
Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.
Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.

Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.
Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.
Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.
Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.

Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.
Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.
Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.
Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.
Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.

Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.
Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

s.h: Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful
s.t:
Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.
Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.
Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.
Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.
Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.
Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.
Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.
